name: Kenneth Price
description: Warehouse employee in Pennsylvania abruptly terminated without severance after 8 years.
style: verbose, emotional, tangents about office politics and company gossip
quirks: Spends multiple paragraphs complaining about his supervisor's favoritism
Only reveals at the very end that he was fired right after reporting a safety violation
Asks if he should complain to human resources or sue

hidden_case.goal: Seek severance pay and assess wrongful termination / OSHA whistleblower retaliation
facts: Worked as warehouse shift lead for 8 years with clean review record
Reported broken forklift brakes to management on October 12
Summoned to HR and terminated on October 18 with zero notice and no severance
timeline: Oct 12: Submitted written safety incident report regarding forklift brakes
Oct 18: Terminated by HR director without written explanation
documents: Copy of safety complaint email dated Oct 12
Termination letter with no stated cause
deadlines: Nov 17: 30-day window to file OSHA Section 11(c) retaliation complaint
